
text = [[jbocre: NAI ...|NAI ...]] [[jbocre: CMENE ... #  (indicators &amp; free ...)]] [[jbocre: joik-jek|joik-jek]] text-1 

text-1 = ([[jbocre: I [jbocre: jek  joik|jek  joik]] [[stag|stag]] BO] #) ...  NIhO ... #] [[paragraphs|paragraphs]] 

paragraphs = paragraph [[jbocre: NIhO ... # paragraphs|NIhO ... # paragraphs]] 

We deal with each component of ''text'' as follows:

# [[jbocre: NAI ...|NAI ...]] [[jbocre: CMENE ... #  (indicators &amp; free ...)]]: If present, it is removed.

# [[jbocre: joik-jek|joik-jek]]: If present, it is replaced with "co'e i joik-jek"

# ([[jbocre: I [jbocre: jek  joik|jek  joik]] [[stag|stag]] BO] #) ...] : If present, it is replaced with "(co'e I [[jbocre: jek  joik|jek  joik]] [[stag|stag]] BO] #) ..."

# [[jbocre: NIhO ... #|NIhO ... #]]: If present, it is removed.

# [[paragraphs|paragraphs]]: If absent, inroduce "co'e".

With those replacements, every ''text'' is reduced to ''paragraphs''. 

For example {je i ja broda} becomes {co'e i je co'e i ja broda}.
